purpose: Define bounded rekey/rotation of transport session material without changing peer, connection or application identity.

owns: Transport Key Rotation and Rekey semantics

topics.name: Transport Key Rotation and Rekey
topics.purpose: Define bounded rekey/rotation of transport session material without changing peer, connection or application identity.

semantics.key_rule: Old/new session-key material versions are explicit metadata refs.
semantics.overlap_rule: Transition overlap/grace is explicit and bounded.
semantics.failure_rule: Failed rekey enters explicit degraded/close/retry policy.
semantics.identity_rule: Rekey does not create new peer/application identity.
semantics.authority_rule: New key material does not change application rights.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

references.purpose: Rekey preserves exact transport session identity.
